'''Alternate Universe''' is the sixth expansion of [[Star Trek CCG 1st Edition]]. It is published by [[Decipher]] on 1 November 1995. The set consists of 122 cards.

'''Alternate Universe''' is available in 15-card booster packs. There are 36 booster packs in one booster box. The set contains the first Ultra-Rare card '''Future Enterprise''' (1:121 packs). The ultra rare card is three times as rare as any one rare. There are 42,335 ultra rare cards printed.

The print run for this set is 142,294 boxes.

This set is noted for the following:
* The first expansion to introduce Doorways
* The first expansion to introduce dual affiliation cards
* Introduced the Alternate Universe icon
* Through errata, Tasha Yar - Alternate is the first character with the Download icon
* Introduced an alternative version of an established personnel card (Major Rakal aka Deanna Troi)
* The first expansion to introduce the ANIMAL classification

The 122 cards of '''Alternate Universe''' introduce the idea of opening "doorways" to other dimensions. Experience time travel, parallel universes and alternate timelines. Play blackjack at the Royale Casino. Attempt a new dimension of missions. Contains the ultra-rare Future Enterprise...use it to travel to the ends of your spaceline at warp speed. You can even find Data's Head! This set expands the game play into surreal worlds and different phases of existence.

==Errata Cards==

The following cards have had corrections made by [[The Continuing Committee]] (see [[Physical Errata Cards]]). These cards are virtual cards.

*Artifact
**Cryosatellite - Iconian Gateway - Ressikan Flute

*Dilemma
**Cardassian Trap - Conundrum - Edo Probe - Frame of Mind - Malfunctioning Door - Parallel Romance - Thought Fire (errata's twice) - Zaldan

*Doorway
**Devidian Door (errata'd twice)

*Event
**Baryon Buildup - Captain's Log - Engage Shuttle Operations - Klim Dolkachin - Lower Decks - Revolving Door (errata'd twice) - Rishon Uxbridge - Yellow Alert

*Facility
**Neutral Outpost

*Interrupt
**Brain Drain - Kevin Uxbridge: Convergence - Humuhumunukunukuapua'a - Latinum Payoff - Phaser Burns - Senior Staff Meeting - Temporal Narcosis - Thine Own Self - Vulcan Nerve Pinch

*Mission
**Diplomatic Conference (twice) - FGC-47 Research - Reunion

*Personnel
**Montgomery Scott (Federation) - Tasha Yar - Alternate (Federation) - Ajur (Non-Aligned) (errata'd twice) - Boratus (Non-Aligned) - Dathon (Non-Aligned) - Major Rakal (Romulan)

==Additional Information==
*'''Alternate Universe''' was printed on 121 card sheets by Carta Mundi, Belgium on Superlux card stock.
*Each print sheet consisted of an 11 x 11 format.
*The Common sheet had 3 sets of commons, plus an extra copy of [[Alternate Universe Door (AU)|Alternate Universe Door]].
*The Uncommon sheet had 3 sets of uncommons, plus 1 copy of [[Ophidian Cane]].
*The Rare sheet had 3 sets of rares, not including [[Ophidian Cane]] , but with 1 [[Future Enterprise (AU)|Future Enterprise]].
*The print run for this expansion was 76,828,760 cards.
